checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Silent 9:16 ~15s video with three moving product shots
must.why: Frames suggest shot 1 persists to 6s (still stand scene), the sidewalk is at 10.5s and 14.3s; no studio-floor shot seen, so the shot structure is off.

must.item: Sneaker consistently white leather low-top, white laces, white sole, no logo
must.why: Mostly white with no logo, but sidewalk shoes look like high-tops/mid-tops, and the shoe design shifts between shots.
The first caption is garbled as 'Meet your evydday pair'. The caption at 6s is still the first one, and the other two read correctly.

must.item: Captions within central 70% width and 60% height
must.why: All captions sit near the vertical middle, between about x=85 and x=390 of 480 and y=415 to 440 of 854, so they are within the margins.

must.item: Captions legible and visible long enough
must.why: White text on white shoes has low contrast. The first caption is garbled and overlaps the laces. The 'Shop now' caption is legible but sits over the white laces.

faults.what: First caption is misspelled ('evydday') and the letters are warped
The first caption is still on screen at 6s, so the timing is wrong; the shot cut and caption change do not fall at 5s
The sidewalk shoes look like mid- or high-tops, not low-tops, and the design changes from the stand shots
No studio-floor shot with moving light is visible; the final frames show the sidewalk again
White caption text over white shoes and laces has weak contrast
The stand shot shows two shoes, not one sneaker, and the sole has a slight tan tint in the sidewalk shots

summary: The ad has well-placed captions, but the first caption is misspelled, the shot timing seems off, there is no studio shot, and the sidewalk sneakers look like high-tops, so it needs a redo.
